title: Images Added for Lender Consents Standing on a Vehicle's Record
content:
A vehicle offered as a Keyturn Vehicle Listing whose record carries verified lender consent documents has images added to the figure the marketplace holds, and what is counted is those consents standing on the condition record, whenever they were verified.

- A vehicle carrying two or more verified lender consent documents on its condition record adds 3 images.
- A vehicle carrying exactly one verified lender consent document adds 2 images.
- A vehicle carrying none adds nothing on this ground, an addition of 0 images.

### Points of judgement

*No window.* The count runs over the condition record as a whole; a consent verified four years ago still counts.

*Where the count divides.* At 2 verified consents the first clause governs and 3 images are added; at exactly 1 the second governs and 2 are added; at none the third governs.

*Other documents.* Only lender consent documents are counted here. A vehicle carrying six verified registrations and no consent adds nothing on this ground.
